questions.prompt: Why does the logistic curve bend over as P nears K?

questions.prompt: A student says the population will keep accelerating upwards like a pure exponential. Explain, in two sentences, what actually happens as the population grows.

questions.answer: It settles back down at P = K, because above K the growth rate is negative until the population falls to the carrying capacity.
questions.explanation: Scene 2 shows the high start: its curve falls back and settles at the same P = K as every other start.
questions.prompt: In one sentence, state where a population starting above K settles, and why.
